description:
A native owner reporting that an admitted call it is still running has reached a describable step.

This is a report, not an authority: the app-server accepts it only for a call that is in flight right now under this exact connection, thread, turn, and admission, and it can never start, extend, or complete a call. A native tool that takes minutes would otherwise be a silent gap in the thread.

iconID.description: The icon of the capability doing the work, as its descriptor names it.

title: WhisplyToolProgressReportParams
